ambiguities: PRB-010: the written form when the filter text is empty is not stated. I assumed the empty q part is omitted, as "#/" stands for no filter.
PRB-027 and PRB-046: the profile is not named, so I assumed "default", whose faults fail the title and the comment.
PRB-036: the notice is raised at 400 ms and its 8 s time ends at 8400 ms. I read the clock as having reached 8400 ms when the answer depends on it.
PRB-052: I assumed the page has focus when Escape is pressed, not the address bar.
PRB-034: the rules give the focus of the delete through DEL-T1 ("as in DEL-1") and NAV-T1 row 3. Both end at the place title, so I took that as the answer.
contradictions: SCN-NAV-9 is tagged [terminal], but the package has no terminal modality sheet. Its addresses ("board?...", "card/sl-114") also disagree with the address forms in WEB-1 ("#/..."). The other questions do not depend on this.
